caption:
Two weeks left in the job. One impossible itinerary. Forty-eight hours to get her boss home for Christmas. ❄️

Maya Brooks has handed in her notice. One last job: get hotel magnate Elliot Hale from Brussels to his mother’s chalet in Zermatt by Christmas Eve.

Then a snowstorm and an air traffic control strike shut down half of Europe.

Rerouted for Christmas, Out of Office · Book One. Coming to Kindle and paperback this week.

slides.title: Forty-eight hours to get her boss home for Christmas.

slides.heading: The plan
slides.body: Wheels up from Brussels at ten. Sion by eleven forty. The chalet by one. Maya even has a laminated copy.

slides.heading: The problem
slides.body: A snowstorm. An air traffic control strike. No jet, no helicopter. Just Maya, and a man who has never taken a train on his own.
